why: Leo 2026-11-05: a fast path and a better viewer for github.com links. The App part is glue over App-only types: WebPageTab's per-tab routes (navigate/restore, shared by every routed web page tab), registering the GitHub page with LinkOpener, DiffPages and AppServices closures, openGitHub placing the tab through LinkOpener.open and InternalPageTabStore, two call sites (CmuxAppLinks, AgentTabContent) and the github_right bench command. The page logic, link parsing, diff cache and strings live in CmuxNextGitHubViewer and webviews/src/pages/github.
